entries.zh: 難；困難之事、難做（另一读指災難、禍患）
entries.en: A difficult thing; hard to do. (With the other reading: calamity, misfortune.)
entries.notes: R 栏并列两读（nān : nân），M 栏 lān lān ūy 疑为「難」与「難為」连书，故释义取首义而附灾难义。

entries.zh: 有入無出；有去無回，難得善終之事
entries.en: A hard case with a bad end: what goes in never comes out.
entries.notes: R 栏首字 ièn 与「有」的官话常读不合，然 L/H/M 三栏互证，义甚明。

entries.zh: 深奧；精深而難懂
entries.en: Profound and difficult; abstruse.
entries.notes: H 作「深難」，M 栏 ô 当指「奧」（深奧），义相通。

entries.zh: 難為；難以做到、令人為難（又指勞煩他人）
entries.en: Hard to do; a troublesome matter (also: to put someone to trouble).

entries.zh: 深；深厚、深奧
entries.en: Deep; profound.

entries.zh: 崎；陡峭難行，難以攀登
entries.en: Steep and hard to climb; rough going.
entries.notes: M 栏两音节（gǔia/quiá）系同一「崎」的异读记录；西语 agrio 在此当「陡峭难行」解。

entries.zh: 難；難做、費力
entries.en: Difficult; arduous.
entries.notes: H 为「難」而 M 栏 ô 乃闽南语「惡（僫）」义为「难」的口语词，非「難」字本音。

entries.zh: 難開口；不便明說、難以啟齒
entries.en: Hard to say; what one cannot speak of.

entries.zh: 難待；難以等待，因令人厭煩
entries.en: Hard to wait for, because it wearies one.

entries.zh: 崎斜；陡峭傾斜，難以攀登
entries.en: Steep and slanting, hard to climb.

entries.zh: 崎成壁；陡峭如牆，極難攀登
entries.en: Steep as a wall; very hard to climb.

entries.zh: 難處；難以處理、難以補救
entries.en: Hard to remedy; difficult to deal with.

entries.zh: 難用人；人才難得、用人不易
entries.en: Hard to employ people; men are hard to use or find.
entries.notes: 西语原句讹误（callar… hermoso lo nezesario），汉文三栏一致指「用人不易」，故据汉文定谳。

entries.zh: 難相處；與人難以共處
entries.en: Hard to get along with; difficult to live with.
entries.notes: 西语 asnitad 疑为 amistad（情谊）之讹，全句当读作「难以与人相处」。

entries.zh: 死人；死者、死亡
entries.en: Dead person; the dead; death.
entries.notes: R 栏两音节次序与「死人」不合（zǐn 似对应「人」），H/M/L 三栏则一致。

entries.zh: 入殮之死者；已裝入棺木的遺體
entries.en: A dead person laid in the coffin; the encoffined dead.
entries.notes: 「抵棺厝」字面为置棺于厝（棺屋／置放），据西语 ataud（棺）定其入殓义。

entries.zh: 硝（借作「消」之音，用于「消化」一词）
entries.en: Nitre, saltpetre (used here phonetically for 消 in 消化, 'to digest').
entries.notes: 词头 Digesis 疑为 Digestión（消化）之讹；本页第 18–19 条「化」「消化」同属此义域，故「硝」当为记音字。

entries.zh: 化；轉化，（食物）化解消融
entries.en: To transform; to digest (food).

entries.zh: 消化；食物在體內化解吸收
entries.en: To digest; digestion.

entries.zh: 位；官階品位；又作稱人的敬量詞（西语所谓 numerales de dignidades）
entries.en: Rank, dignity, position; also the honorific numeral (classifier) for persons.

entries.zh: 欽位；欽授之官位、尊位
entries.en: Imperially conferred rank; a dignity bestowed by the emperor.
entries.notes: M 栏三音节与「欽位」二字不合（末音节 chêuy 未详），释义据 H/R 与西语 Dignidad 定。
